You're getting this **npm `ERESOLVE` dependency conflict** because your project is using **`expo@44.0.6`**, but the `@hashgraph/sdk@2.14.2` package expects **`expo@^45.0.3`**.

---

### 🔥 Problem Breakdown

- `@hashgraph/sdk@2.14.2` requires:
  - `@hashgraph/cryptography@1.1.2`, which needs `expo@^45.0.3`
- You currently have `expo@44.0.6`
- This mismatch leads to an **unresolvable peer dependency conflict**

---

### ✅ Solutions

#### **Option 1: Upgrade `expo`**
Upgrade your Expo version to **at least `45.0.3`** (you can even go to latest if possible):
```bash
npm install expo@^45.0.3
```

> ⚠️ Only do this if you're sure your codebase and other Expo dependencies are compatible with Expo 45+. If you're on SDK 44 and moving to 45, check the [Expo SDK 45 Migration Guide](https://blog.expo.dev/expo-sdk-45-f9ca0f273598).

---

#### **Option 2: Use `--legacy-peer-deps`**
If upgrading Expo breaks other parts of your app, you can **bypass the peer dependency checks** (less safe):

```bash
npm install --legacy-peer-deps
```

> 🚨 This ignores peer dependency conflicts, but can cause **runtime errors** if packages truly aren't compatible.

---

#### **Option 3: Use `--force`**
If you absolutely must install it and accept broken dependencies (not recommended):

```bash
npm install --force
```

> ⚠️ This is **last resort**. You're telling npm to ignore sanity checks.

---

### 🧠 Recommendation (TL;DR)

If you're building a new or modern project, **upgrade `expo` to 45 or 46**, and install dependencies cleanly:

```bash
npm install expo@^45.0.3
npm install
```

If you're stuck on Expo 44, try `--legacy-peer-deps`, but **test thoroughly**.

---

Let me know your current project setup (Expo SDK version, whether you're using React Native), and I can help you pick the safest fix.
